thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: outbound-pager-queue lag > 90s and drop_count increased. routing to oncall suppressed by cutoff window.

maria: seeing 504s from pagerbridge outbound webhook, and a bunch of 410s. looks like some webhooks are being rejected.

alex: confirmed. logs show `webhook_handler: signature verification failed` for a stream of messages starting 09:14 UTC.

ben: that lines up with a key rotation last night. did the deploy rotate signing keys? deploy-bot: deployed pager-bridge v2.3.1 at 2025-11-18T02:12Z (sha: a1b2c3).

samira: automation did not create the incident channel because the incoming webhook lacked `service_id` metadata (the parser returns null and channel-creator aborted). so no channel was opened and no pages were shown.

maria: customer-impact estimate: estimated ~70 external pages suppressed for customers on EU region, some high-priority flows affected (payments retry).

oncall-phone: I got zero pages, only a slack DM from ops-bot. phone line didn't ring.

alex: quick mitigation: manually call the oncall team and restart the pager-bridge process to flush stale key cache. running `systemctl restart pager-bridge.service` now.

ben: oncall contacted. restarting... `sudo systemctl restart pager-bridge.service` -> returned exit 0.

ops-bot: INFO: pager-bridge restarted at 09:21 UTC, re-registering webhook subscriptions.

maria: reprocessing outbound queue with replay tool: `./bin/replay-outbound --from=2025-11-18T09:10Z --to=2025-11-18T09:22Z --dry-run=false`

alex: logs after restart show signature checks passing. sample log: ```
2025-11-18T09:22:07Z INFO webhook_handler verify=ok id=svc-payments uid=1234
2025-11-18T09:22:08Z INFO outbound dispatch queued id=evt-9876 target=phone
```

samira: we called the few oncall numbers for customers with active incidents. ops team manually escalated two pages.

ben: root cause hypothesis: deploy rotated signing keys but the live key cache expired before new subscribers updated their webhook metadata. that, plus the outbound-queue cutoff logic, caused items to be treated as stale and PRUNE'd without channel creation.

maria: mitigation actions: 1) add defensive fallback in channel-creator to still create a channel when `service_id` missing but `priority` present, 2) add a reconciliation job to surface pruned outbound messages to a triage queue, 3) revert key rotation roll-forward for 1-hour fail-safe window.

oncall-phone: acked. I'm adding a manual checklist to the runbook and calling affected customers who reported missing pages.

alex: filing an incident task: `INC-2025-847` with timeline and list of affected customers.

ops-bot: RECOMMENDATION: emergency hotfix patch to skip prune for 5m while replay runs. patch branch `hotfix/pager-prune-skip`.

samira: deploying hotfix to staging now. will roll to prod after smoke.

deploy-bot: deploy started for hotfix/pager-prune-skip -> staging (id=deploy-7788).

maria: postmortem owners: samira (integration), alex (deploy), ben (playbook), maria (customer comms). scheduled follow-up doc + retro. :spiral_calendar:

alex: ETA for full remediation and postmortem ready by EOD. we'll also add alerting for `prune_count > 0` to surface next time. :thumbsup:
